decisions.statement: An error is known by the crash signature of its message and its traceback.
An error never seen before is carried up.
An error seen before is carried up only when its count has risen.
An error whose count has not risen is left alone.
An error the game had already unloaded is held back rather than carried up.
An error held back is counted as suppressed.
A count is recorded for every error read.
An error held back has its count recorded all the same.
The highest count read for one signature is the count recorded.
A time the game gave in seconds is carried up in milliseconds.
A missing traceback is carried up as an empty string.

definition: which of the game's Lua errors the watcher carries up and which it holds back
